text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Tail score (mean of the 0.01 and 0.99 pinball losses) of the first arm minus the second, after the spread factor, on the rows experiment 210's mask keeps. Grey line: no difference. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.'
